english.note: This is the everyday choice when a quantity has become less; it is the all-purpose colloquial equivalent when decrease means become smaller.
Use this casual expression when something has itself become less, rather than when someone actively reduces it.

examples.english: I recently noticed my pay decrease.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 faat3 gok3 fan6 loeng4 siu2 zo2

examples.english: All this recent rain has made the number of people on the streets lessen.
examples.traditional: 呢排落雨，街上嘅人少咗。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 gaai1 soeng6 ge3 jan4 siu2 zo2
